data.case_title: Debt collection letter from EuroClaim Forderungsmanagement (suspected scam)
data.explanation: This letter shows several classic scam warning signs: an extremely short 72-hour payment deadline, a payment account held by a private individual abroad (Lithuania) rather than the alleged creditor, threats of criminal prosecution and account seizure without any prior court order, and the false claim that objecting is "pointless." In Germany, you always have the right to dispute a debt collection claim, and a bank account can only be seized after a court judgment and enforcement order — a collection agency cannot do this on its own. Do not transfer any money to the account given. If you never knowingly signed up for this subscription, do not respond under pressure; instead verify the claim independently, for example with the Verbraucherzentrale (consumer advice centre) or a lawyer, before doing anything.

data.title: Last warning before seizure – "Lotto-Muster-Club" subscription (suspected scam)
warnings: This has strong hallmarks of a fake debt-collection scam: the payment account is a Lithuanian IBAN held by a private individual (A. Petrauskas), not the German 'Lotto-Muster-Club' creditor, which is unusual for a legitimate collection agency.

The 72-hour deadline and threats of immediate account seizure, a SCHUFA entry and criminal prosecution 'without further notice' are high-pressure tactics; a German bank account can only be seized after a court judgment, not directly by a collection agency.
The claim that 'a Widerspruch (objection) is pointless and only causes further costs' is misleading — in Germany you always retain the right to dispute a debt collection claim.
The added collection and account fees (€84.00 + €24.00) are large relative to the claimed principal debt of €179.40, which is atypical of legitimate collection costs.

The sender is registered only abroad (Cyprus) with no German address, which is common in fraudulent debt-collection schemes targeting people in Germany; verify independently before paying or responding.
